title: Languages
description: The languages the site offers. Each falls back to another for anything not translated, then to the default language and English.
fallbackHelp: Used for any text not given in this language, before the default language and English.
progress: {done} of {total, plural, one {# text} other {# texts}} ({percent}%)
deleteDescription: Its translations of {product}’s texts are removed with it. This can’t be undone.
codeHelp: A BCP 47 code: fr, tr, fr-CA. It can’t be changed later.
afterAdding: After adding it, translate {product}’s texts on its Translate page, or import a file a translator filled in. Until then it shows the fallback’s texts.
editor.title: Translate: {name}
editor.description: Every text of {product}, with the English it’s written in. Leave a text empty to use what ships, or the fallback language. Saved changes show on every page at once.
editor.saved: Saved {saved, plural, one {# translation} other {# translations}} and removed {removed}.
editor.importHint: A JSON file of nested texts, as Export gives it. Texts that match what ships are skipped; unknown keys are listed, never stored.
editor.outdatedHint: The English text changed after this was translated. Check it and save it again.
editor.page: Page {page} of {pages} · {count, plural, one {# text} other {# texts}}
editor.leaveDescription: {count, plural, one {# change isn’t saved and will be lost.} other {# changes aren’t saved and will be lost.}}
